Contract AutomatedTellerMachineSystem::checkBalance(): Real {
	definition:
		inputCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.Password = InputCard.Password and
		o.CardID = InputCard.CardID),
		obs: Set(BankCard) = BankCard.allInstance()->select(o|o.CardStatus = CardStatus.NORMAL),
		isValidated: Boolean = if PasswordValidated = true and
		CardIDValidated = true and
		inputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		isValidated = true and
		obs.size()<>0 and
		inputCard.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let inputCard: BankCard in
		inputCard.oclIsNew() and
		obs->includes(inputCard) and
		inputCard.Balance = inputCard.Balance and
		result = inputCard.Balance
}
